messages.author: b8bc28031ee4107a
messages.subject: occasions
parts:
Hi everyone
I'm running a multi-season SECR.  In some models, I have had data errors, and in their attributes, I find that the number of occasions per season is only one.

SECR1:
                      S1    s2
Occasions    1      1
Detections   45    80
Animals        8      5
Detectors    47    66
Count model: Poisson

SECR2:
                      S1    s2
Occasions   100    92
Detections   45    80
Animals        8      5
Detectors    47    66
Count model: Poisson

> AICcompatible(secr1,  secr2)
  data     CL groups   hcov binomN
 FALSE   TRUE   TRUE   TRUE   TRUE

 The models that have errors are as follows:
secr1=secr.fit(Bafq, model=list(D~1, g0~1, sigma~1),
               mask=clippedmask, CL=TRUE, trace=FALSE, verify = FALSE)
secr4=secr.fit(Bafq, model=list(D~1, g0~"Sex", sigma~1),
               mask=clippedmask,CL=TRUE, trace=FALSE)
secr5=secr.fit(Bafq, model=list(D~1, g0~1, sigma~"Sex"),
               mask=clippedmask, CL=TRUE, trace=FALSE)
secr6=secr.fit(Bafq, model=list(D~1, g0~(h2), sigma~1),
               mask=clippedmask, CL=TRUE, trace=FALSE, hcov="Sex")

Can you guide me?

Best regards
Ali

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: occasions
parts:
It's a little hard to tell as you switch case and do not give all the models, but I expect this is due to the default behaviour of secr >=4.0 to collapse multiple occasions at proximity detectors within a session, whenever this is 'safe'. This is fast when it works, but unfortunately it can lead to inconsistencies such as you have found. You can take control by setting details = list(fastproximity = FALSE) for all models. See secr-version4.pdf.
Murray
